author: Kevin Wang (KevinChunye)
method: C++20 PathFinder negotiation (slow, fanout-weighted present costs, A* for single-sink nets) + exact per-net shortest-path-tree reroute with random equal-delay ties + large-neighbourhood search with negotiated group repair; threshold acceptance cooling linearly to 0 with kicks and return to best; hard and congested: start threshold 32, move type chosen by a discounted Thompson-sampling bandit, 4 threads adopting the best every fifth of the run; designs: start threshold 8, threads sync every 10 s; budgets 600 s (hard) and 1800 s (congested, designs) per case; one config per tier; from scratch
